title: De-duplicate 7 public type names defined in two files each (AG-4)

evidence.quote: CurriculumSummary, PaceCalculator, PaceIndicator, PaceStatus, PinFlowMode, PinFlowStep, StudyDayPattern each defined in 2 lib/ files (script scan; pairs in appendix)

why: Agents locate code by grep; a duplicated public name sends them to the wrong definition and breeds divergent parallel copies — this repo's documented accretion failure. PaceCalculator/PaceStatus duplicated across features is exactly how two pace algorithms drift apart silently.
recommendation: For each pair: keep one canonical definition (core/ or the owning feature), rename or delete the other, and land the AG-4 duplicate-symbol audit script so the count ratchets to zero.
acceptance_criteria: AG-4 audit script lands in make audit and reports zero duplicate public top-level type names
each of the 7 names resolves to exactly one lib/ definition
